sections.installation:
Follow These Steps To Quickly Install Xpro Addons For Elementor

  1. Install Xpro Addons For Elementor via WP Plugin Directory or by uploading the plugin file to your server in the wp-content/plugins folder.
  2. After successful installation, simply click on the ‘Activate’ button to use Xpro Addons For Elementor.
  3. Once the plugin is activated, navigate to the Xpro Addons option on the WP sidebar. You will see the Xpro Addons Dashboard where you can explore Xpro Elementor Extensions, Templates, User Data options, and Featured Addons which you can use to build amazing websites.
  4. Now open Elementor Page Builder by editing any Page/Post and start creating beautiful websites. A Page Builder option will also be available in the WP Admin Panel on the front end of your website (if logged in).

Check our detailed installation guide for Xpro Addons For Elementor for a better understanding of the installation process. If you face any difficulty during the installation process, please feel free to contact our 24/7 customer support.

Absolutely not! Our Elementor Addons is a complete drag’n’drop suite that requires ZERO coding skills. It is developed for people who want to quickly design amazing websites.

Our Elementor Addons is a cleanly coded plugin that won’t affect the speed of your website negatively. It is made to speed up the design process and make Google love your websites.

All your Free addons for elementor including 50+ free widgets remain free?

Yes, absolutely! We are well established company over more than 10 years of experience with two offices in USA. Our main goal is to develop something new and creative.
